body_lead: VIJAYAWADA: Across India, States are experimenting with Artificial Intelligence (AI) to improve public service delivery. Andhra Pradesh, however, is attempting something more ambitious -- integrating AI into the core architecture of governance itself. Rather than deploying isolated AI pilots, the State is building an interconnected digital ecosystem that combines citizen services, real-time governance, data analytics and welfare delivery.
